tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open main draw set — Zverev & Sabalenka top seeds as qualifying wraps today after rain delays; first round Sunday Aug 30 • [SQUASH] World Squash Masters Championships open Aug 30 in Perth — accreditation & opening ceremony Aug 29 • [BADMINTON] BWF Worlds wrap — France's first men's singles & mixed doubles golds; An Se-young reclaims title in New Delhi • [PICKLEBALL] MLP Finals NYC Aug 28–30 — NJ 5s, Brooklyn, St. Louis & Dallas battle at Wollman Rink; CBS title match Sunday • [TABLE TENNIS] ETTU Champions League Stage 1 Aug 28–30 — 16 men's clubs in Lille & 8 women's clubs in Budaörs chase knockout spots

newsItems.title: US Open Draw Set, Qualifying Wraps
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026 US Open main draw was released Aug 27 — Zverev and Sabalenka lead the fields as rain pushes the final qualifying round to Friday; first-round play begins Sunday at Flushing Meadows.

newsItems.title: MLP Finals Hit Central Park
newsItems.excerpt: The DoorDash MLP Finals run Aug 28–30 at CityPickle in NYC's Wollman Rink, with the NJ 5s, Brooklyn, St. Louis Shock and Dallas Flash in best-of-three semifinals and a Sunday CBS championship.

newsItems.title: BWF Worlds Crown New Champions
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026 BWF World Championships closed in New Delhi with France's first men's singles and mixed doubles titles, An Se-young reclaiming women's singles gold, and India's Treesa-Gayatri earning women's doubles bronze.

newsItems.title: ETTU Champions League Stage 1 Begins
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026/27 ETTU Champions League opens Aug 28–30 with men's Stage 1 in Lille (16 clubs, top two per group advance) and women's Stage 1 in Budaörs (eight clubs, two group winners progress).
